title: TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo fails at the base commit in this worktree: run-epic reads the gate before the executor refusal
body: internal/cli TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo expects `ticfac run-epic x` to exit 2 with 'no executor configured', but the binary exits 1 first with 'read the gate configuration: ... no such file' when internal/cli/.tick/runners.toml does not exist. Reproduced identically at 7dbb8ca8fe17 with my changes stashed, so it is pre-existing and outside this tick; it may be worktree-layout dependent (the test builds a binary and runs it in the package dir).
